narrative.overview: A clean, monochrome workspace where the plan, the 3D model and the numbers are the content and the interface stays out of the way.
keyCharacteristics: Monochrome gray and white; near-black is the primary action color.
Large rounded corners (12px and 16px); pills for steps and status.
Red, amber and green reserved for print and inspection status.

rules.name: The Status-Only Color Rule
rules.body: Red, amber and green mean a print or inspection state and nothing else.

rules.name: The One Ink Rule
rules.body: Near-black is the single action color.

rules.name: The Border-First Rule
rules.body: Separate surfaces with a hairline border or a tonal fill before reaching for a shadow.

dos: Do keep surfaces white and gray-50 with 1px hairline borders.
Do keep red, amber and green for print and inspection status.
donts: Don't add a second brand color for buttons or links.
